title: My Town
text:
My town is small. There is a big park near my house. Every Sunday, I walk in the park with my dog. There is also a library next to the park.

In the centre of town, there is a market. My mother buys fruit and vegetables there. The market is open every day. There is a bakery across the street, too.

questions.text: Where does my mother buy fruit and vegetables?
How does the writer probably feel about the park?
What kind of town is it most likely?
options: A quiet, small town with friendly places
A very large city with no parks
A town with no shops at all
A town far away from the sea

vocabulary.definition: an outdoor area with grass and trees where people can walk
a place where people can borrow books
a place where people buy food and other goods, often outdoors
a shop that sells bread and cakes

paragraph_translations: Minha cidade é pequena. Há um parque grande perto da minha casa. Todo domingo, eu caminho no parque com o meu cachorro. Há também uma biblioteca ao lado do parque.
No centro da cidade, há um mercado. Minha mãe compra frutas e verduras lá. O mercado está aberto todos os dias. Há também uma padaria do outro lado da rua.
